payload.expected_mechanism: A Writer-skill revision that (1) enumerates every explicitly stated requirement and example from the issue as a checklist before editing, (2) verifies each item locally (minimal reproduction or direct shell check) before finalizing, and (3) on a failed retry pursues a different approach rather than a minor variation.
payload.hypothesis: All four v3r3 H0 failures (astropy, sympy, pytest, sphinx) produced real patches that failed official evaluation; all four finished with real patches that passed visible tests but failed official evaluation. The subject already carries the round-1 empty-patch prohibition, so failures are repair-quality gaps: single-interpretation patches that pass visible tests but miss stated requirements. Hypothesis: requiring requirement enumeration with per-item local verification and a different-approach retry converts a subset of these failures into rescues while all six H0-resolved regression cases stay green. A hypothesis from the evolution-failure projections, not causal truth.
validation_plan: Freeze the candidate through the governed request/Writer/check/commit path with the attribution bound.
Execute the evolution set (four H0 failures) under the frozen H1 with identical inputs.
Execute the complete regression set (all six H0-resolved cases) under the frozen H1; any regression rejects the candidate and triggers governed rollback.
